mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may lower levetiracetam seizure threshold and increase CNS adverse effects; both drugs have independent CNS effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and seizure control closely; maintain adequate hydration and consider amphotericin B lipid formulations to reduce nephrotoxicity; adjust levetiracetam dose if renal impairment develops.
